subject.title: fix(config): restore redacted array values by item identity

question: Should a mutable config `id` be treated as the authoritative identity for redacted restoration, or should the Control UI carry a separate immutable row identity so any id rename requires deliberate secret re-entry?
rationale: The edited snapshot cannot distinguish a deletion from a rename to a removed row's id, so code alone cannot safely satisfy both ordinary deletion semantics and the PR's stated fail-closed rename guarantee.

options.title: Carry immutable row identity
options.body: Add non-user-editable identity metadata to the snapshot or save contract, and reject any row whose visible id changed while it still contains a redacted placeholder.

options.title: Define id as authoritative
options.body: Keep id-based matching and document that renaming to a previously used id adopts that id's retained secret semantics rather than failing closed.

recommendation.title: Carry immutable row identity
recommendation.body: Add non-user-editable identity metadata to the snapshot or save contract, and reject any row whose visible id changed while it still contains a redacted placeholder.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor supplied the reproduction and resolver design needed to clarify the intended row-identity contract.
